subject: english
title: 八上英语同步章节卷 · Units 3–4
label: Units 3–4 Same or Different? · Amazing Plants and Animals
unit: 八上·Units 3–4 Same or Different? / Amazing Plants and Animals
source: 人教版八年级上册 Unit 3 Same or Different?、Unit 4 Amazing Plants and Animals：形容词和副词的比较级、as ... as、much 修饰比较级、“the＋比较级, the＋比较级”、最高级（the＋-est / the most、one of the＋最高级＋复数）、描述朋友的异同、动植物之最。按八年级单元测试题型编写（不含听力），百分制

items.stem: My sister is two years ______ than me, but I'm taller than her.
items.exp: 有 than，用比较级 older。

items.stem: Tom runs ______ than any other student in his class.
items.exp: “比任何其他学生都……”用比较级＋than any other＋单数名词，表示最高级的意思。fast 的比较级是 faster。

items.stem: This book is as ______ as that one. You can read either of them.
items.exp: as＋形容词原级＋as，表示“和……一样”。

items.stem: Lucy is ______ outgoing than her twin sister. She loves talking with people.
items.exp: 多音节形容词 outgoing 的比较级是 more outgoing。

items.stem: The Yangtze River is ______ river in China.
items.exp: 在中国所有河流中最长，用最高级；形容词最高级前要加 the。

items.stem:
—Which is ______, the sun, the moon or the earth?
—The sun.
items.exp: 三者比较用最高级；big 双写 g 加 -est，前面加 the。

items.stem: My best friend and I are different ______ many ways.
items.exp: in many ways 在很多方面。

items.stem: It's ______ colder today than yesterday. Put on your coat.
items.exp: 修饰比较级用 much、a little、even、far 等，不能用 very、too。

items.stem:
—Is Mike ______ funny ______ his brother?
—No, he isn't. He's quieter.
items.exp: 疑问句“和……一样”用 as ... as；funny 是原级，不能和 than 搭配。

items.stem: Giant pandas are one of ______ animals in the world.
items.exp: one of the＋最高级＋名词复数，“最……的……之一”。

items.stem: The more you practise, ______ you will become.
items.exp: “the＋比较级, the＋比较级”表示“越……就越……”。

items.stem: A good friend is like a mirror. She always ______ me the truth.
items.exp: tell sb. the truth 告诉某人实话。

items.stem: Of all the land animals, the cheetah runs ______.
items.exp: Of all ... 范围内比较用最高级；副词最高级前的 the 可以省略。

items.stem: This plant is very special. It can live ______ water for months.
items.exp: very special 提示：能在没有水的情况下活几个月，用 without。

items.stem:
—Thanks for helping me with my maths.
—______ That's what friends are for.
items.exp: 回应感谢用 You're welcome / It's my pleasure。Never mind 回应道歉。

sections.title: Different but Close
sections.passage:
Kate and I are best friends, but we are quite different. Kate is (16) than me, and she has long straight hair. I'm shorter and my hair is curly. Kate is more outgoing. She loves talking and making new friends. I'm (17). I prefer reading books at home.
In class, Kate is good at maths, and I'm (18) at English than she is. So we often help each other. When I can't (19) a maths problem, Kate explains it to me patiently. When Kate has trouble with her English writing, I check it for her.
Some people think friends should be the (20). I don't agree. Kate and I are different, but we (21) many things in common. We both love animals, and we both want to be vets in the future.
I think a good friend doesn't need to be (22) you. A good friend is someone who (23) you and helps you become a better person. Kate makes me more (24) — now I'm not afraid to speak in front of the class. I hope our friendship will last (25).

items.exp: 后一句 I'm shorter，说明 Kate 比我高。
Kate 更外向，我更安静，喜欢在家看书。
有 than，用比较级；英语比她好，所以能帮她检查作文。
solve a problem 解决问题。
下一句“我不同意。我们不一样，但……”，说明有人认为朋友应该相同：the same。
have ... in common 有共同之处。
be like sb. 像某人。好朋友不一定要和你一样。
好朋友是理解你、帮你变得更好的人。
现在敢在全班面前发言了，变得更外向。
希望友谊长存：last forever。

groups.label: A
groups.title: Amazing Plant Facts
groups.passage:
The tallest tree: a coast redwood in California, the USA. It is about 116 metres tall.
The oldest tree: a bristlecone pine in the USA. It is more than 4,800 years old.
The biggest flower: the rafflesia in Southeast Asia. It is about 1 metre wide, and it smells like bad meat!
The fastest-growing plant: some kinds of bamboo. They can grow about 90 centimetres in one day.
The smallest flowering plant: the watermeal. It is smaller than a grain of rice.

items.stem: How tall is the tallest tree?
items.exp: It is about 116 metres tall。

items.stem: Where can we find the biggest flower?
items.exp: the rafflesia in Southeast Asia。

items.stem: What do we know about the rafflesia?
items.exp: it smells like bad meat，闻起来不好。

items.stem: How much can some kinds of bamboo grow in one day?
items.exp: They can grow about 90 centimetres in one day。

items.stem: Which plant is smaller than a grain of rice?
items.exp: The smallest flowering plant: the watermeal. It is smaller than a grain of rice。

groups.label: B
groups.title: The Bird with the Longest Journey
groups.passage:
The Arctic tern is a small seabird. It weighs only about 100 grams, but it holds an amazing record: it makes the longest journey of any animal in the world.
Every year, Arctic terns fly from the Arctic, near the North Pole, to the Antarctic, near the South Pole, and then fly back again. The round trip is about 70,000 kilometres. Because they follow the summer, they see two summers every year. They enjoy more daylight than any other animal on the earth.
How do they fly so far? They don't fly in a straight line. They follow the winds, so they can save energy. They can also catch fish from the sea on the way.
An Arctic tern can live for about 30 years. In its life, it may fly about 2.4 million kilometres — that's like flying to the moon and back three times!

items.stem: How heavy is an Arctic tern?
items.exp: It weighs only about 100 grams。

items.stem: Why do Arctic terns see two summers every year?
options: Because they follow the summer between the Arctic and the Antarctic.
Because they fly in a straight line.
items.exp: 北极和南极的夏天正好错开，它们跟着夏天飞，所以一年经历两个夏天。

items.stem: How do Arctic terns save energy?
options: By eating a lot of fish.
By flying in a straight line.
items.exp: They follow the winds, so they can save energy。坑点：原文说它们不走直线。

items.stem: How far may an Arctic tern fly in its life?
items.exp: In its life, it may fly about 2.4 million kilometres。70,000 千米是一年往返一次的距离。

items.stem: Which word best describes the Arctic tern?
items.exp: 体重只有约 100 克，却保持动物迁徙最远的纪录，令人惊叹。

sections.title: Me and My Best Friend
sections.passage:
I'm in Grade 8 now, and I'm quite different from two years ago. I'm (36) (tall) than before — I grew 10 centimetres! Two years ago I was shy, but now I'm much (37) (outgoing). I talk with my classmates (38) (happy) every day.
My best friend Leo is (39) (fun) person in our class. Everyone laughs at his jokes. He is (40) ______ hard-working as I am. But at home he is (41) (lazy) than me — he never makes his bed! Our English teacher says we both write (42) (good) than last year.
Grade 8 is (43) (busy) than Grade 7, but it's also more interesting. I think it's important (44) (make) progress every day. We don't have to be the (45) (good), but we can try to be better than yesterday.

items.exp: 有 than，用比较级 taller。
much 修饰比较级；outgoing 是多音节词，用 more outgoing。
修饰动词 talk 用副词；happy 变 y 为 i 加 -ly。
在班里最有趣，用最高级 the funniest；fun 的形容词是 funny。
as＋原级＋as，后面已有 as，空里填 as。
有 than，用比较级；lazy 变 y 为 i 加 -er。
修饰动词 write，有 than，用 well 的比较级 better。
有 than，busy 变 y 为 i 加 -er。
It's important to do sth.，it 是形式主语。
前面有 the，用最高级 best。

sections.prompt:
请以“My Best Friend and I”为题，写一篇短文比较你和好朋友：1. 外貌上的相同或不同（至少一点）；2. 性格、爱好上的相同或不同（至少两点）；3. 你们怎样互相帮助，你认为好朋友应该是什么样的。要求：80 词左右，题目已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
My Best Friend and I
points: 性格、爱好比较（至少两点）
互相帮助和对好朋友的看法
语言正确（比较级、as ... as、最高级），书写规范
sections.sample:
My Best Friend and I
My best friend is Lin. We are in the same class, but we are different in many ways.
Lin is taller than me, and her hair is longer than mine. She is more outgoing than I am. She loves sports and plays basketball every day. I'm quieter and I like reading. But we are both interested in music, and she sings as well as I do.
We often help each other. She helps me with PE, and I help her with Chinese. I think a good friend doesn't need to be the same as you. The best friend is someone who understands you and makes you better.
sections.exp: 写完检查：有 than 用比较级（tall→taller、busy→busier、outgoing→more outgoing、good / well→better）；as 和 as 中间用原级；三者以上比较才用最高级，前面加 the。
